mcdonald-s.name: McDonald's
mcdonald-s.description: McDonald's Corporation is an American multinational fast food restaurant chain founded in 1940 in San Bernardino, California. By the end of 2025, it operated 45,356 restaurants in over 100 countries, with approximately 95% run by franchisees.

magnit.name: Magnit
magnit.description: Magnit is one of Russia's largest food retailers, founded in 1994 in Krasnodar by Sergey Galitsky. The company operates thousands of stores including convenience stores, hypermarkets, and cosmetics stores. It has a significant presence across many locations in Russia.

macy-s-inc.name: Macy's, Inc.
macy-s-inc.description: Macy's, Inc. is an American holding company of department stores. Established in 1929 as Federated, it acquired Macy's in 1994, a department store chain originally founded in 1858. The company has a history of acquisitions and divestitures involving various regional department store chains.

meituan.name: Meituan
meituan.description: Meituan is a Chinese technology company based in Beijing that operates a platform for local services such as on-demand food delivery, in-store services, hotel and travel bookings, and instant retail. Founded in 2010, it launched its initial public offering on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2018.

magna-international.name: Magna International
magna-international.description: Magna International Inc. is a Canadian automotive supplier and one of the largest companies in Canada. It is the largest manufacturer of original equipment automobile parts in North America and supplies major automakers including General Motors, Ford, BMW, and Tesla.

michelin.name: Michelin
michelin.description: Compagnie Générale des Établissements Michelin SCA, known as Michelin, is a French multinational tyre manufacturer based in Clermont-Ferrand, France.

medtronic-plc.name: Medtronic plc
medtronic-plc.description: Medtronic plc is an international medical device company with legal and executive headquarters in Ireland and operational headquarters in Minneapolis, Minnesota. It develops and manufactures healthcare technologies and therapies and operates in more than 150 countries.

marks-spencer.name: Marks & Spencer
marks-spencer.description: Marks and Spencer p.l.c. is a major British multinational retailer based in London, England. It specializes in clothing, beauty, home, and food products and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index.

morgan-stanley.name: Morgan Stanley
morgan-stanley.description: Morgan Stanley is an American multinational banking institution headquartered in New York City. It is the sixth-largest bank in the United States and operates regional offices in 42 countries worldwide. The bank is considered a systemically important financial institution by the Financial Stability Board.

maanshan-iron-steel-company-limited.name: Maanshan Iron & Steel Company Limited
maanshan-iron-steel-company-limited.industry: Iron and steel industry in communist china
maanshan-iron-steel-company-limited.description: Maanshan Iron & Steel Company Limited, known as Masteel, is a Chinese steel manufacturing company based in Ma'anshan, Anhui province. Established in 1993, it was controlled by Chinese governments and since June 2019 is indirectly owned by China Baowu Steel Group. The company is listed and operates in the steel industry.

mechel.name: Mechel
mechel.description: Mechel is a Russian mining and metals company headquartered in Moscow. It produces coal, iron ore concentrate, steel, and rolled steel products. The company sells its products domestically and internationally and is formally known as Public Joint Stock Company Mechel.

mitsubishi-heavy-industries.name: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries
mitsubishi-heavy-industries.description: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational engineering, electrical equipment, and electronics corporation headquartered in Tokyo. It is a core company of the Mitsubishi Group and its automobile division preceded Mitsubishi Motors.

mckesson-corporation.name: McKesson Corporation
mckesson-corporation.description: McKesson Corporation is an American publicly traded company headquartered in Irving, Texas. It distributes pharmaceuticals and provides health information technology, medical supplies, and health management tools, delivering a third of all pharmaceutical products used in North America.

mahindra-mahindra.name: Mahindra & Mahindra
mahindra-mahindra.description: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited is an Indian automobile manufacturer headquartered in Mumbai. Established in 1945, it is part of the Mahindra Group and is one of the largest SUV manufacturers in India. It also leads globally in tractor production and manufactures commercial vehicles through subsidiaries.

mobile-telesystems.name: Mobile TeleSystems
mobile-telesystems.description: Mobile TeleSystems (MTS) is the largest telecommunications company and mobile network operator in Russia and Belarus, headquartered in Moscow. It operates on GSM, UMTS, LTE, and 5G standards and offers various services including local telephone, broadband, and multiple television formats.

mobile-world-investment-corporation.name: Mobile World Investment Corporation
mobile-world-investment-corporation.description: Mobile World Investment Corporation is a Vietnamese publicly listed retailer operating nationwide chains including thegioididong.com, Dien May Xanh, Bach Hoa Xanh grocery, and An Khang pharmacies. It is listed on the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange since 2014.

man-se.name: MAN SE
man-se.description: MAN SE was a manufacturing and engineering company based in Munich, Germany. It specialized in commercial vehicles and diesel engines through its divisions MAN Truck & Bus and MAN Latin America, and had a stake in the manufacturer Sinotruk.

minebeamitsumi.name: MinebeaMitsumi
minebeamitsumi.description: MinebeaMitsumi, Inc. is a Japanese multinational manufacturer of mechanical components and electronic devices. Its headquarters are in Higashi-Shinbashi, Minato, Tokyo, with a registered office in Miyota, Nagano.

motorola.name: Motorola
motorola.description: Motorola, Inc. was an American multinational telecommunications company based in Schaumburg, Illinois. Founded in 1928 as Galvin Manufacturing Corporation, it produced radio-related communication equipment and was split into Motorola Solutions and Motorola Mobility in 2011.

mazda.name: Mazda
mazda.description: Mazda Motor Corporation is a Japanese multinational automotive manufacturer headquartered in Fuchū, Hiroshima, Japan. Founded in 1920 as a cork-making factory, it started producing vehicles in 1931. The company was originally named Toyo Cork Kogyo Co., Ltd. before changing to Toyo Kogyo Co., Ltd.

mitsubishi-motors.name: Mitsubishi Motors
mitsubishi-motors.description: Mitsubishi Motors Corporation is a Japanese multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It was the sixth-largest Japanese automaker in 2011 and joined the Renault–Nissan–Mitsubishi Alliance in 2016.

mastercard.name: Mastercard
mastercard.description: Mastercard Inc. is an American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in Purchase, New York. It processes payments between banks of merchants and card-issuing banks or credit unions globally.

minor-food-group.name: Minor Food Group
minor-food-group.description: Minor Food Group is a subsidiary of Minor International and one of the largest restaurant chains in the Asia Pacific region. Founded in 1980 by William E. Heinecke, it is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. The company operates casual dining, quick service restaurants, food service, and delivery.

marfrig.name: Marfrig
marfrig.description: Marfrig S.A. is a Brazilian food processing company headquartered in São Paulo. It operates 33 production units worldwide and exports to over 100 countries. The company produces and distributes food based on animal protein and is one of the largest beef producers globally.

mapfre.name: MAPFRE
mapfre.description: Mapfre, S.A. is a Spanish multinational insurance company based in Majadahonda, Madrid. It is the leading insurance company in Spain and the largest non-life insurance company in Latin America. The company originated from a mutual insurance background.

maxxis.name: Maxxis
maxxis.description: Cheng Shin Rubber Industry Co. is a Taiwanese tire company established in 1967 in Yuanlin City, Changhua County. It is the 16th largest tire manufacturer globally. Maxxis Tyres and CST tires are wholly owned subsidiaries of Cheng Shin.

magazine-luiza.name: Magazine Luiza
magazine-luiza.description: Magazine Luiza S.A. is a Brazilian retail company known as Magalu. It operates in the retail sector in Brazil and is led by chairperson Luiza Trajano and CEO Frederico Trajano.

mondi-group.name: Mondi Group
mondi-group.description: Mondi plc is a multinational packaging and paper group based in Weybridge, England. It is listed on both the Johannesburg Stock Exchange and the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company specializes in papermaking and packaging products.

monsanto.name: Monsanto
monsanto.description: The Monsanto Company was an American agrochemical and agricultural biotechnology corporation headquartered in Creve Coeur, Missouri. Founded in 1901, it was known for products like the Roundup herbicide and genetically engineered crops before ceasing to exist as an independent company.

magnitogorsk-iron-and-steel-works.name: Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works
magnitogorsk-iron-and-steel-works.description: Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works (MMK) is an iron and steel company located in Magnitogorsk, Russia. As of 2017, it was the 30th largest steel company worldwide.

meritor.name: Meritor
meritor.description: Meritor, Inc. is an American corporation headquartered in Troy, Michigan. It manufactures automobile components for military suppliers, trucks, and trailers. Meritor is recognized as a Fortune 500 company.

micro-star-international.name: Micro-Star International
micro-star-international.description: Micro-Star International Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese multinational corporation based in New Taipei City. The company designs, develops, and provides computer hardware and related products including laptops, motherboards, graphics cards, and automotive infotainment systems.

motorola-solutions.name: Motorola Solutions
motorola-solutions.description: Motorola Solutions, Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It provides safety and security products and services including critical communications and video security technologies. The company was formed in 2011 as the legal successor to Motorola, Inc.

m-video.name: M.video
m-video.description: PJSC M.video is a leading Russian e-commerce and consumer electronics retailer. It unites the M.Video and Eldorado brands in its retail operations.

makita.name: Makita
makita.description: Makita Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of power tools founded in 1915 and based in Anjō, Japan. It operates factories in several countries including Brazil, China, Japan, and the United States.

millicom.name: Millicom
millicom.description: Millicom International Cellular S.A., known as Millicom, is a Luxembourg-domiciled telecommunications provider operating exclusively in Latin America under the Tigo brand. Its registered office is in Luxembourg City, with principal executive offices in Doral, Florida. The company is listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market in the United States.

m-dias-branco.name: M. Dias Branco
m-dias-branco.description: M. Dias Branco S.A. is a Brazilian multinational company headquartered in Eusébio, Ceará. It manufactures, markets, and distributes biscuits, pasta, cakes, snacks, wheat flour, margarine, and vegetable shortening throughout Brazil.

mtu-aero-engines.name: MTU Aero Engines
mtu-aero-engines.description: MTU Aero Engines AG is a German aircraft engine manufacturer. It develops, manufactures, and services engines for military and civil aircraft and was formerly known as MTU München.

morningstar-inc.name: Morningstar, Inc.
morningstar-inc.description: Morningstar, Inc. is an American financial services firm headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. Founded in 1984 by Joe Mansueto, it provides investment research and investment management services.

maxim-integrated.name: Maxim Integrated
maxim-integrated.description: Maxim Integrated Products, Inc. was an American semiconductor company based in San Jose, California. It designed, manufactured, and sold analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits for various markets including automotive and communications. The company was acquired by Analog Devices in 2021.

maybank-of-indonesia.name: MayBank of Indonesia
maybank-of-indonesia.description: PT Bank Maybank Indonesia Tbk is a private bank in Indonesia and part of Maybank, one of the largest financial services groups in ASEAN. It operates within the Indonesian financial services sector.

magyar-telekom.name: Magyar Telekom
magyar-telekom.description: Magyar Telekom Nyrt. is a leading telecommunications service provider based in Hungary. It operates as a subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom. The company is a key player in the Hungarian telecommunications industry.

maaden.name: Maaden
maaden.description: Maaden, also known as the Saudi Arabian Mining Co., is a Saudi state-owned mining company headquartered in Riyadh. It was established in 1997 to develop Saudi Arabia's mineral resources. The Saudi government owns 50% of its shares, with the rest publicly traded on Tadawul.

moderna.name: Moderna
moderna.description: Moderna, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical and biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It focuses on RNA therapeutics, primarily mRNA vaccines that use messenger RNA to instruct protein production for immune responses.

mongodb-inc.name: MongoDB Inc.
mongodb-inc.description: MongoDB, Inc. is an American software company that develops and supports the MongoDB database engine for unstructured data. It has expanded its product to include features like ACID and transactions to appeal to enterprise customers.

molson-coors-brewing-company.name: Molson Coors Brewing Company
molson-coors-brewing-company.description: Molson Coors Beverage Company is a Canadian-American multinational brewing company. It is the fifth-largest brewer worldwide by beer output. The company has operational headquarters in Chicago and offices in Prague, Golden, Colorado, and Montréal, Québec.

meda-ab.name: Meda AB
meda-ab.description: Meda AB is a specialty pharmaceutical company headquartered in Solna, Sweden. It imports and markets pharmaceuticals, nutritional, and health-care products, and provides services such as clinical research, registration, and logistics. Meda's pharmaceuticals are sold in more than 150 countries.

moscow-city-telephone-network.name: Moscow City Telephone Network
moscow-city-telephone-network.description: The Moscow City Telephone Network is a public joint-stock company providing local telephone and internet services to over 4 million subscribers in Moscow, Russia. It is known by the Latin acronym MGTS.

motor-oil-hellas.name: Motor Oil Hellas
motor-oil-hellas.description: Motor Oil (Hellas) Corinth Refineries S.A. is a petroleum industry company based in Greece. It focuses on oil refining and trading and is a leading force in its sector in Southern Europe and the Mediterranean.

mitsui-chemicals.name: Mitsui Chemicals
mitsui-chemicals.description: Mitsui Chemicals is a Japanese chemicals company listed on the Nikkei with business interests in Japan, Europe, China, Southeast Asia, and the USA. It deals mainly in performance materials, petrochemicals, basic chemicals, and functional polymeric materials. The company is part of the Mitsui conglomerate.

mueller-water-products.name: Mueller Water Products
mueller-water-products.description: Mueller Water Products, Inc. is a publicly traded company based in Atlanta, Georgia. It manufactures and distributes fire hydrants, gate valves, and other water infrastructure products in North America through its two business units, Mueller Co. and Mueller Technologies.

manitou-group.name: Manitou Group
manitou-group.industry: Manufacture of lifting and handling equipment
manitou-group.description: Manitou is a French heavy equipment manufacturer founded in 1957 and headquartered in Ancenis. It produces forklifts, cherry pickers, telehandlers, and other heavy equipment, originating with the design of the first rough terrain forklift truck.

matas.name: Matas
matas.description: Matas is a Danish company founded in 1949 that operates a chain of drug stores across Denmark. It sells cosmetics, personal hygiene products, household chemicals, and vitamin supplements.

makemytrip.name: MakeMyTrip
makemytrip.description: MakeMyTrip Limited is an Indian online travel company headquartered in Gurgaon. Founded in 2000, it operates a platform for booking airline tickets, hotel reservations, holiday packages, and rail and bus tickets.

mil-moscow-helicopter-plant.name: Mil Moscow Helicopter Plant
mil-moscow-helicopter-plant.description: Mil Moscow Helicopter Plant is a Russian helicopter designer and manufacturer headquartered in Tomilino, Moscow. It operates as a subsidiary of Russian Helicopters. The company is involved in mechanical engineering within the aerospace sector.

mobileye.name: Mobileye
mobileye.description: Mobileye Global Inc. is an autonomous driving company headquartered in Israel and domiciled in the United States. It develops AI technologies including self-driving and advanced driver-assistance systems as well as humanoid robotics. Mobileye was acquired by Intel in 2017 and went public again in 2022.

materion.name: Materion
materion.description: Materion Corp. is a multinational company specializing in high-performance advanced materials. Its products include advanced beryllium metals, thin film deposition materials, high-performance alloys, composites, and specialty coatings. The company operates in the industrials and chemicals sector.

multilaser.name: Multilaser
multilaser.description: Multilaser, also known as Multi, is an electronics company based in Brazil. It operates in the electronics industry and serves the Brazilian market.

moldova-agroindbank.name: Moldova Agroindbank
moldova-agroindbank.description: maib is Moldova's largest commercial bank and lender.

mindbody.name: MINDBODY
mindbody.description: Mindbody, Inc. is a software-as-a-service company based in San Luis Obispo, California. It provides cloud-based online scheduling and business management software for the wellness services industry. The company has offices in the US, UK, Australia, and India, with a worldwide distributed workforce and a remote work policy established in 2023.

mtn-syria.name: MTN Syria
mtn-syria.description: MTN Syria is one of two mobile operators in Syria, formerly known as Areeba. It offers GSM, 3.5G, and 4G (LTE) broadband and mobile services in the country.

mitsubishi-estate.name: Mitsubishi Estate
mitsubishi-estate.description: Mitsubishi Estate Company, Limited is one of Japan's largest real estate developers. The company is involved in property management as well as architecture research and design.

mahaka-media.name: Mahaka Media
mahaka-media.description: PT Mahaka Media Tbk, traded as Mahaka X since 2022, is an Indonesian media and entertainment company founded by Erick Thohir. It owns printed newspapers Harian Republika and Harian Indonesia, a magazine, a regional TV station JakTV, and a radio station.

merkur-bank.name: Merkur Bank
merkur-bank.description: Merkur Privatbank is a German private bank headquartered in Munich. It is owner-managed and operates in the financial services sector. The bank is based in Germany.

merlin-properties.name: Merlin Properties
merlin-properties.description: MERLIN Properties SOCIMI, S.A. is a Spanish real estate investment trust focused on acquiring and managing commercial assets and infrastructure in the Iberian Peninsula. Its operations include office, shopping center, logistics, and data center segments. The company is based in Spain.

melhusbanken.name: MelhusBanken
melhusbanken.description: Melhus Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Melhus Municipality, Norway. Its main market is the southern part of Trøndelag county. Established in 1840, it is one of Norway’s oldest savings banks.

montea-company.name: Montea (company)
montea-company.description: Montea NV is a publicly traded real estate company based in Aalst, Belgium, specializing in logistics and industrial real estate development and management. It operates in Belgium, the Netherlands, France, and Germany with a portfolio of over 120 locations totaling more than 2.3 million m².

melco-holdings.name: Melco Holdings
melco-holdings.description: Melco Holdings Inc. is a family business founded in 1975 and located in Japan. The company is known for its brand Buffalo Inc. and operates in the computer hardware industry.

medigen-vaccine-biologics.name: Medigen Vaccine Biologics
medigen-vaccine-biologics.description: Medigen Vaccine Biologics Corporation is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in Neihu, Taipei, Taiwan. It operates in the biotechnology industry focusing on vaccine development and biologics.

ministop.name: Ministop
ministop.description: Ministop Co., Ltd., a member of AEON, operates the Ministop convenience store franchise in Japan. Its stores feature kitchens preparing fresh food and seating areas for customers to eat on-site.

mr-diy.name: MR.DIY
mr-diy.description: MR.DIY is a Malaysian multinational discount variety store chain founded in Kuala Lumpur in 2005. It offers a wide range of home improvement products and general merchandise, with over 6,000 stores across 15 countries as of August 2026. The stores typically carry more than 17,000 product varieties.

mp-materials.name: MP Materials
mp-materials.description: MP Materials Corp. is an American rare-earth materials company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. It owns and operates the Mountain Pass mine, the only operating rare earth mine and processing facility in the United States. The company focuses on producing neodymium-praseodymium used in high-strength permanent magnets for advanced technologies.

medivir.name: Medivir
medivir.description: Medivir is a Swedish biotech company focusing on oncology and innovative pharmaceuticals addressing unmet medical needs. It conducts pharmaceutical development in-house and through partnerships and has expertise in protease inhibitors and nucleotide science. Medivir is listed on the Nasdaq Stockholm Mid Cap List.

matterport.name: Matterport
matterport.description: Matterport LLC is an American 3D spatial mapping company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. Founded in 2011, it became publicly traded in 2021 and was acquired by CoStar Group in 2025.

morinaga-company.name: Morinaga & Company
morinaga-company.description: Morinaga & Company, Ltd. is a Japanese confectionery company headquartered in Tokyo, founded in 1899. Its products include candy such as Hi-Chew and other confectioneries.

mishorim-development.name: Mishorim Development
mishorim-development.description: Mishorim Development Ltd. is an Israeli public company founded in 1990 and traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. It owns historic sites and buildings in various countries, including Canada and the United States.

myer.name: Myer
myer.description: Myer is an Australian department store chain operating across all Australian states and one self-governing territory. It offers a wide range of products including clothing, footwear, cosmetics, homewares, and food.

martifer.name: Martifer
martifer.description: Martifer SGPS, S.A. is a family group based in Oliveira de Frades, Portugal. It focuses on metal construction and renewable energy sectors and employs over 3,000 people.

monotaro.name: MonotaRO
monotaro.description: MonotaRO Co., Ltd. is a Japanese e-commerce company specializing in industrial supply products. It is based in Osaka, Japan. The company was recognized on Forbes Asia's "Best Under A Billion" list in 2013.

mandom.name: Mandom
mandom.description: Mandom Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer and distributor of hair care, skin care, perfumes, and deodorants. Founded in 1927 as Kintsuru Perfume Corporation, it changed its name to Tancho Corporation in 1959 and to Mandom Corporation in 1971. The company operates in the consumer goods sector in Japan.

miroku-corp.name: Miroku Corp.
miroku-corp.description: Miroku Corporation is a Japanese firearms manufacturer located in Nankoku, Kōchi Prefecture. It produces shotguns for Browning Arms Company and rifles licensed by Winchester Firearms, sold under both Miroku and Browning brand names in European markets. The company operates in the arms industry.

meiji-holdings.name: Meiji Holdings
meiji-holdings.description: Meiji Holdings Company, Ltd. is a Japanese holding company established in 2009 after the stock transfer from Meiji Seika and Meiji Dairies. It is the fourth largest confectionery company in the world.

mbank.name: mBank
mbank.description: mBank SA is a bank based in Warsaw, Poland. It offers retail, corporate, and investment banking along with other financial services and is the successor of BRE Bank after rebranding in 2013.

mda-space.name: MDA Space
mda-space.description: MDA Space Ltd. is a Canadian space technology company headquartered in Brampton, Ontario. It provides geointelligence, robotics, space operations, and satellite systems.

megmilk-snow-brand.name: Megmilk Snow Brand
megmilk-snow-brand.description: Megmilk Snow Brand Co., Ltd., formerly Snow Brand Milk Products Co., Ltd., is one of the largest dairy companies in Japan.

miss-grand-international-company.name: Miss Grand International (company)
miss-grand-international-company.description: Miss Grand International is a Thai conglomerate founded in 2013 and headquartered in Bangkok. It operates businesses across various industries including advertisement, cosmetics, entertainment, events, health products, and talent management.

mandarin-oriental-hotel-group.name: Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group
mandarin-oriental-hotel-group.description: Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group International Limited is a multinational hospitality and management company based in Bermuda. It focuses on luxury hotels, resorts, and residences, owning or partially owning 20 of its 46 properties worldwide.

maspion-bank-of-indonesia.name: Maspion Bank of Indonesia
maspion-bank-of-indonesia.description: PT Bank Maspion Indonesia Tbk is an Indonesian banking and financial services company established in 1989 and based in Surabaya. It is part of the Kasikornbank group of companies. The company operates in the banking sector.

mayora-indah.name: Mayora Indah
mayora-indah.description: PT Mayora Indah Tbk is a large Indonesian multinational food and beverage company headquartered in Jakarta. Founded in 1977, it is recognized as the world's largest coffee candy manufacturer through its Kopiko brand. The company operates in the food industry.

mondelez-international.name: Mondelez International
mondelez-international.description: Mondelez International, Inc. is an American multinational company based in Chicago that produces confectionery, food, beverages, and snack foods. It operates in approximately 160 countries and was ranked No. 108 in the 2021 Fortune 500 list of largest U.S. corporations by revenue.

meyer-burger.name: Meyer Burger
meyer-burger.description: Meyer Burger Technology AG is an industrial manufacturer of solar cells and solar modules headquartered in Gwatt, Thun, Switzerland. Its registered shares are listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

maoye-international.name: Maoye International
maoye-international.description: Maoye International Holdings Limited is a leading department store company based in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China. It operates retail businesses in Guangdong, Sichuan, Chongqing, and Jiangsu provinces.

mothercare.name: Mothercare
mothercare.description: Mothercare plc is a global brand offering products for parents and young children. The company is listed on the AIM stock exchange in London, United Kingdom.

mbia.name: MBIA
mbia.description: MBIA Inc. is an American financial services company founded in 1973 as the Municipal Bond Insurance Association. It is headquartered in Purchase, New York. As of 2015, the company had approximately 180 employees.

man-group.name: Man Group
man-group.description: Man Group plc is an active investment management firm headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It provides investment funds for institutional and private investors and is the world's largest publicly traded hedge fund company. The company was a sponsor of the Man Booker Prize from 2002 to 2019.

mitsubishi-materials.name: Mitsubishi Materials
mitsubishi-materials.description: Mitsubishi Materials Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of cement products, copper and aluminum products, cemented carbide tools, and electronic materials. It is one of the core companies of the Mitsubishi Group. The company is based in Japan.

manpowergroup.name: ManpowerGroup
manpowergroup.description: ManpowerGroup is an American multinational corporation headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Founded in 1948, it is the third-largest staffing firm globally and provides administrative, professional, and business services through its four primary brands.

maxygen.name: Maxygen
maxygen.description: Maxygen Inc. was a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Redwood City, California. It focused on developing improved versions of protein drugs using DNA shuffling and other protein modification technologies. The company was dissolved in 2013.

medivation.name: Medivation
medivation.description: Medivation, Inc. was an American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It focused on developing novel therapies to treat serious diseases with limited treatment options. The company began operations in 2004 and its final CEO was David Hung.

magic-software-enterprises-ltd.name: Magic Software Enterprises Ltd.
magic-software-enterprises-ltd.description: Magic Software Enterprises Ltd is a global enterprise software company headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel. It was listed on Nasdaq and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange until its sale to Matrix IT Ltd. in February 2026.

marathon-oil.name: Marathon Oil
marathon-oil.description: Marathon Oil Corporation was an American company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration. In November 2024, it was acquired by ConocoPhillips.

monotype.name: Monotype
monotype.description: Monotype Imaging Holdings Inc., founded in 1887 in Philadelphia, is an American company specializing in digital typesetting and typeface design for consumer electronics. Based in Woburn, Massachusetts, it developed many widely used typefaces including Times New Roman, Gill Sans, and Arial.

mitsubishi-gas-chemical-company.name: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company
mitsubishi-gas-chemical-company.description: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company, Inc. is a Japanese company operating in the chemical industry. The summary provides limited information beyond its nationality and industry classification.

medialink-group.name: Medialink Group
medialink-group.description: Medialink Group Limited is a content distributor and licensor based in Kowloon, Hong Kong. It specializes in distributing Japanese anime and brand licensing, with offices located on Mody Road, Tsim Sha Tsui.

mizuho-financial-group.name: Mizuho Financial Group
mizuho-financial-group.description: Mizuho Financial Group, Inc. is a Japanese banking holding company headquartered in the Ōtemachi district of Chiyoda, Tokyo. It was formed between 2000 and 2002 by merging Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, Fuji Bank, and Industrial Bank of Japan. The name Mizuho means "abundant rice" or "harvest" in Japanese.

metsa-board.name: Metsä Board
metsa-board.description: Metsä Board Oyj is a Finnish producer of fresh fibre paperboards, including folding boxboards and food service boards. It is part of Metsä Group, one of the largest forest industry groups globally.

moelis-company.name: Moelis & Company
moelis-company.description: Moelis & Company is a global investment bank providing financial advisory services to corporations, governments, and financial sponsors. It advises on mergers and acquisitions, recapitalizations, restructurings, and other corporate finance matters.

mercury-insurance-group.name: Mercury Insurance Group
mercury-insurance-group.description: Mercury General Corporation is a multiple-line insurance organization offering personal automobile, homeowners, renters, and business insurance. Its primary focus is on automobile and homeowners' insurance in the United States.

mccarthy-stone.name: McCarthy & Stone
mccarthy-stone.description: McCarthy Stone is a developer and manager of retirement communities based in the United Kingdom. The company specializes in housing solutions for retirees, focusing on community living. It operates exclusively within the UK market.

mccoll-s.name: McColl's
mccoll-s.description: McColl's was a British convenience shop, newsagent, and post office operator founded in 1973. It operated under different names including RS McColl's in Scotland and Martin's for its newsagent-format shops. The company was based in the United Kingdom.

mimecast.name: Mimecast
mimecast.description: Mimecast Limited is a British information security company founded in 2003 and headquartered in London. It specializes in email security and risk management. The company is owned by Permira, a British private equity firm.

matomy-media.name: Matomy Media
matomy-media.description: Matomy Media Group Ltd. is an Israeli publicly traded company that was formerly involved in performance-based and programmatic advertising solutions. By the end of 2019, all its advertising operations were sold or closed. The company has been publicly traded since July 2014.

mingyuan-medicare-development-company-li.name: Mingyuan Medicare Development Company Limited
mingyuan-medicare-development-company-li.description: Mingyuan Medicare Development Company Limited is a Bermuda-incorporated company headquartered in Hong Kong. Its main business has been based in mainland China for the past 15 years. The company was formerly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

metro-realty.name: Metro Realty
metro-realty.description: PT Metro Realty Tbk. is a real estate and property management company based in Jakarta, Indonesia. It operates primarily in the real estate industry within the country.

mackinac-financial-corporation.name: Mackinac Financial Corporation
mackinac-financial-corporation.description: Mackinac Financial Corporation was a bank holding company based in Manistique, Michigan. It provided commercial and retail banking products through its bank, mBank. The company was incorporated in 1974 and was acquired by Nicolet National Bank in 2021.

medassets.name: MedAssets
medassets.description: MedAssets, Inc. was an American healthcare performance improvement company. It provided products and services to thousands of hospitals and non-acute healthcare providers. The company operated in the United States.

mattersight-corporation.name: Mattersight Corporation
mattersight-corporation.description: Mattersight Corporation, formerly eLoyalty, is a publicly traded company based in Chicago, Illinois. Founded in 1994, it provides SaaS-based enterprise behavioral analytics software focusing on customer-employee interaction and behavior.

markit.name: Markit
markit.description: Markit was a British financial information and services company founded in 2003 that focused on credit derivative pricing.

medpace.name: Medpace
medpace.description: Medpace Holdings, Inc. is a global clinical research organization based in Cincinnati, Ohio. It offers a full-service model including central laboratory, imaging, ECG core laboratory, and bioanalytical laboratory services. The company also operates a Phase I unit at its headquarters.

mississippi-power.name: Mississippi Power
mississippi-power.description: Mississippi Power is an electric utility company headquartered in Gulfport, Mississippi. It is a subsidiary of Southern Company, based in Atlanta. The company provides electric utility services in its region.

m-a-com-technology-solutions.name: M/A-COM Technology Solutions
m-a-com-technology-solutions.description: MACOM Technology Solutions, Inc. is an American developer and producer of radio, microwave, and millimeter wave semiconductor devices. Headquartered in Lowell, Massachusetts, it was the city's largest private employer in 2005. The company holds ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certifications.

medmen.name: MedMen
medmen.description: MedMen Enterprises was a United States-based cannabis company headquartered in Culver City, California. It operated retail stores and cultivation facilities across multiple states and was publicly traded on the Canadian Securities Exchange and over-the-counter in the U.S. before its stock was delisted in 2024.

mutares.name: Mutares
mutares.description: Mutares SE & Co. KGaA is an international private equity investor focused on special situations. It specializes in acquiring parts of large corporations and companies undergoing transitional phases. The company is based in Germany.

marsh-mclennan-companies.name: Marsh & McLennan Companies
marsh-mclennan-companies.description: Marsh & McLennan Companies is an American professional services firm headquartered in New York City. It operates in insurance brokerage, risk management, reinsurance, talent management, investment advisory, and consulting, and is the largest insurance broker worldwide.

mitsui-fudosan.name: Mitsui Fudosan
mitsui-fudosan.description: Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. is a major Japanese real estate developer with properties worldwide. It is one of the core companies of the Mitsui Group. The company is based in Japan.

methode-electronics.name: Methode Electronics
methode-electronics.description: Methode Electronics is an American multinational company headquartered in Southfield, Michigan. It operates engineering, manufacturing, and sales operations in more than 35 locations across 14 countries and employs around 6,500 people worldwide.

minerva-foods.name: Minerva Foods
minerva-foods.description: Minerva Foods is a Brazilian food company founded in 1924 in Barretos, São Paulo. It operates in the agriculture and food industry.

marcopolo.name: Marcopolo
marcopolo.description: Marcopolo S.A. is a Brazilian manufacturer of buses, coaches, and rail vehicles founded in 1949 in Caxias do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul. It produces various types of coach bodies including microbus, intercity, and touring models.

meitu.name: Meitu
meitu.description: Meitu Inc. is a Chinese technology company headquartered in Xiamen, Fujian, established in 2008. It produces smartphones and selfie applications.

mts-systems-corporation.name: MTS Systems Corporation
mts-systems-corporation.description: MTS Systems Corporation is a United States-based supplier of test and simulation systems. It provides test and measurement products to assess the performance and reliability of vehicles, aircraft, civil structures, biomedical materials, and raw materials. Notable products include aerodynamics simulators, seismic simulators, and hydraulic actuators.

misc-group.name: MISC Group
misc-group.description: MISC Berhad, formerly Malaysia International Shipping Corporation Berhad, is Malaysia's leading international shipping line. It operates a fleet of over 120 vessels and is involved in ship owning, operating, offshore facilities, marine repair, and engineering. Its main shareholder is Petronas, Malaysia's national oil conglomerate.

marshall-ilsley.name: Marshall & Ilsley
marshall-ilsley.description: Marshall & Ilsley Corporation was a U.S. bank and diversified financial services company based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. It was acquired by Bank of Montreal in 2010.

maxell.name: Maxell
maxell.description: Maxell, Ltd. is a Japanese company that manufactures consumer electronics. It is commonly known simply as Maxell.

mccormick-company.name: McCormick & Company
mccormick-company.description: McCormick & Company, Incorporated is an American food company that produces, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments, and other flavoring products. Its customers include retail outlets, food manufacturers, and food service businesses.

meredith-corporation.name: Meredith Corporation
meredith-corporation.description: Meredith Corporation was an American media conglomerate based in Des Moines, Iowa, owning newspapers, magazines, television stations, and websites. Its publications had a large readership and its broadcast stations reached 11% of U.S. households. Since 2021, Meredith has been part of Dotdash Meredith under IAC Inc.

mesa-air-group.name: Mesa Air Group
mesa-air-group.description: Mesa Air Group, Inc. was a Nevada-based commercial aviation holding company headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. It operated Mesa Airlines, which flew as United Express and American Eagle under agreements with United Airlines and American Airlines.

micro-focus-international.name: Micro Focus International
micro-focus-international.description: Micro Focus International plc was a British multinational software and information technology business based in Newbury, Berkshire, England. The firm provided software and consultancy services. It was listed on the London and New York Stock Exchanges until its acquisition by OpenText in January 2023.

mikuni.name: Mikuni
mikuni.description: Mikuni Corporation is a Japanese automotive products manufacturer focused on carburetors, fuel injectors, and other automobile and motorcycle related equipment. The company operates in the automotive industry in Japan.

mitchells-butlers.name: Mitchells & Butlers
mitchells-butlers.description: Mitchells & Butlers plc operates pubs, bars, and restaurants in the United Kingdom. The company is headquartered in Birmingham, England, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

moneygram.name: MoneyGram
moneygram.description: MoneyGram International, Inc. is an American peer-to-peer payments and money transfer company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It operates an operations center in St. Louis Park, Minnesota, and has regional and local offices worldwide.

monster-beverage.name: Monster Beverage
monster-beverage.description: Monster Beverage Corporation is an American company that manufactures energy drinks such as Monster Energy, Relentless, Reign, and Burn. Founded in 1935 in Southern California as Hansen's, it originally sold juice products. The company renamed itself Monster Beverage in 2012.

mitel.name: Mitel
mitel.description: Mitel Networks Corporation is a Canadian telecommunications company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario. It shifted focus after 2001 from TDM PBX systems to Voice-over-IP, unified communications, collaboration, and contact center products, with offices and partners worldwide.

murphy-usa.name: Murphy USA
murphy-usa.description: Murphy USA is an American corporation based in El Dorado, Arkansas, operating a chain of retail gas stations primarily near Walmart stores. It was founded in 2013 as a spin-off from Murphy Oil.

machhapuchhre-bank.name: Machhapuchhre Bank
machhapuchhre-bank.description: Machhapuchchhre Bank Limited is the first regional commercial bank from western Nepal, registered in 1998. It started operations in 2000 from its head office in Pokhara, located in the foothills of Machhapuchchhre.

mega-bank-nepal-limited.name: Mega Bank Nepal Limited
mega-bank-nepal-limited.description: Mega Bank Nepal Limited was an 'A' class commercial bank licensed by Nepal Rastra Bank. It had branches nationwide with its head office in Kathmandu and provided comprehensive commercial banking services.

mustika-ratu.name: Mustika Ratu
mustika-ratu.description: PT Mustika Ratu Tbk is an Indonesian manufacturer of cosmetics and herbal medicine headquartered in South Jakarta. The company operates a factory in Ciracas to support its business activities.

meredian-holdings-group-inc.name: Meredian Holdings Group Inc.
meredian-holdings-group-inc.description: Danimer Scientific, formerly Meredian Holdings Group Inc., is a biopolymer manufacturer headquartered in Bainbridge, Georgia, United States.

momentum-metropolitan-holdings-limited.name: Momentum Metropolitan Holdings Limited
momentum-metropolitan-holdings-limited.description: Momentum Metropolitan Holdings Limited is a South African financial services group. It is publicly traded on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

magellan-health.name: Magellan Health
magellan-health.description: Magellan Health Inc. is an American for-profit managed health care company and subsidiary of Centene. It focuses on special populations and specialty healthcare areas, serving health plans, employers, unions, military, government agencies, and third-party administrators. It ranked 390 on the Fortune 500 in 2021.

metallurgical-corporation-of-china-limit.name: Metallurgical Corporation of China Limited
metallurgical-corporation-of-china-limit.description: Metallurgical Corporation of China Limited (MCC) is a publicly listed Chinese engineering and construction company. It operates in metallurgical engineering, project contracting, resource development, and real estate. The company is listed on the Shanghai and Hong Kong Stock Exchanges and was formed through corporatization of its parent group's assets.

miniso.name: Miniso
miniso.description: MINISO Group Holding Limited is a Chinese retailer and variety store chain specializing in household and consumer goods such as cosmetics, stationery, toys, and kitchenware. Founded in 2013, its headquarters are in Haizhu District, Guangzhou.

monolithic-power-systems.name: Monolithic Power Systems
monolithic-power-systems.description: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. is an American semiconductor company headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida. It operates in more than 15 locations worldwide. The company is publicly traded.

match-group.name: Match Group
match-group.description: Match Group, Inc. is an American internet and technology company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It owns and operates a large portfolio of online dating services including Tinder and Match.com. The company was spun off from IAC in July 2020.

my-food-bag.name: My Food Bag
my-food-bag.description: My Food Bag is a New Zealand meal-kit home-delivery service that provides customers with ingredients and recipes to cook meals. The company is publicly traded and was listed on the NZX and ASX on 5 March 2021.

mrv-engenharia.name: MRV Engenharia
mrv-engenharia.description: MRV is the largest Brazilian homebuilder and real estate company, founded in 1979 and headquartered in Belo Horizonte. The company was founded by Mário Lúcio Pinheiro Menin, Rubens Menin Teixeira de Souza, and Vega Engenharia Ltda. Its major shareholder is Rubens Menin Teixeira de Souza.

manawa-energy.name: Manawa Energy
manawa-energy.description: Manawa Energy Limited is a New Zealand electricity generation company operating 26 power schemes across the country. It offers bespoke electricity products to commercial and industrial customers. The company serves regions from the Bay of Plenty to Otago.

matrix-concepts-holdings-berhad.name: Matrix Concepts Holdings Berhad
matrix-concepts-holdings-berhad.description: Matrix Concepts Holdings Berhad is a Malaysia-based investment holding company. It is listed on the Malaysian stock exchange under the ticker MYX: 5236. The company operates within the real estate industry.

molecular-partners.name: Molecular Partners
molecular-partners.description: Molecular Partners AG is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Zürich, Switzerland. It develops a new class of small-protein therapies called DARPins for diseases including oncology and infectious diseases. The company has molecules in clinical and preclinical development.

marvelous.name: Marvelous
marvelous.description: Marvelous Inc. is a Japanese video game developer, publisher, and anime producer. The company was founded in 1997 and formed in its current state in 2011 after acquiring AQ Interactive and Liveware.

martela.name: Martela
martela.description: Martela Oyj is a Finnish company that supplies furniture. It is based in Finland and operates in the interior design sector.

maxis-communications.name: Maxis Communications
maxis-communications.description: Maxis Berhad is a Malaysian communications service provider headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. It is one of the oldest and largest telecommunications companies in Malaysia, offering various communication products and services to consumers and businesses. The company covers a wide geographic area within Malaysia.

moscow-exchange.name: Moscow Exchange
moscow-exchange.description: The Moscow Exchange is Russia's largest exchange, operating markets in equities, bonds, derivatives, foreign exchange, money markets, and precious metals. It also manages the National Settlement Depository and the National Clearing Centre. The exchange was formed in 2011 by merging two previous exchanges.

mcafee-llc.name: McAfee, LLC
mcafee-llc.description: McAfee Corp. is an American proprietary software company focused on online protection for consumers worldwide. It is headquartered in San Jose, California. The company has undergone several name changes since its founding in 1987.

maa.name: MAA
maa.description: Mid-America Apartment Communities, Inc. (MAA) is a publicly traded real estate investment trust based in Memphis, Tennessee. It invests in apartments located in the Southeastern and Southwestern United States.

marel.name: Marel
marel.description: Marel is a multinational food processing company headquartered in Garðabær, Iceland. It manufactures equipment and provides services for food processing in the poultry, meat, and fish industries, employing around 8,000 people across 30 countries.

mitsubishi-paper-mills.name: Mitsubishi Paper Mills
mitsubishi-paper-mills.description: Mitsubishi Paper Mills Limited is a Japanese company based in Sumida, Tokyo. It is part of the Mitsubishi and Oji Paper groups and operates in the pulp and paper industry.

msa-safety.name: MSA Safety
msa-safety.description: Mine Safety Appliances, or MSA Safety Incorporated, is an American manufacturer and supplier of safety equipment for hazardous conditions. It serves industries such as construction, military, fire service, and chemical, oil, and gas production. The company is based in Cranberry, a suburb of Pittsburgh.

multistrada-arah-sarana.name: Multistrada Arah Sarana
multistrada-arah-sarana.description: PT Multistrada Arah Sarana is an Indonesian tire manufacturer selling tires under the Achilles and Corsa brands. It operates large factories in East Cikarang and has been a subsidiary of French manufacturer Michelin since 2019.

medical-properties-trust.name: Medical Properties Trust
medical-properties-trust.description: Medical Properties Trust, Inc. is a real estate investment trust headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, United States. It invests in healthcare facilities. The company focuses on real estate related to the healthcare sector.

mitsumi.name: Mitsumi
mitsumi.description: Mitsumi Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of consumer electronic components founded in 1954. It became a subsidiary of MinebeaMitsumi in 2017 after merging with Minebea to form the parent company.

malaysia-airlines.name: Malaysia Airlines
malaysia-airlines.description: Malaysia Airlines Berhad is the flag carrier airline of Malaysia, headquartered at Kuala Lumpur International Airport. It operates flights to destinations across Europe, Oceania, and Asia from its main hub. The airline was formerly known as Malaysian Airline System.

mitsubishi-chemical-holdings.name: Mitsubishi Chemical Holdings
mitsubishi-chemical-holdings.description: Mitsubishi Chemical Group Corporation is a Japanese chemical industry company formed in 2005 from the merger of Mitsubishi Chemical Corporation and Mitsubishi Pharma Corporation. It is headquartered in Tokyo and part of the Mitsubishi conglomerate.

m-t-bank.name: M&T Bank
m-t-bank.description: M&T Bank Corporation is an American bank holding company headquartered in Buffalo, New York. It operates over 940 branches across 12 states and Washington D.C. in the Eastern United States. The holding company was formerly named First Empire State Corporation until 1998.

mmx-mineracao.name: MMX Mineração
mmx-mineracao.description: MMX Mineração is a mining company in Brazil and Chile, part of the EBX Group founded in 2005. It focuses on extraction, beneficiation, and sale of iron ore and minerals. The company filed for bankruptcy in 2016 and its bankruptcy was upheld in 2021.

maisons-du-monde.name: Maisons du Monde
maisons-du-monde.description: Maisons du Monde is a French furniture and home decor company founded in Brest in 1996. It operates 349 stores in Europe, with 212 in France, and employs over 5,500 people. Nearly half of its sales are made online and 45% of sales come from abroad.

masisa.name: Masisa
masisa.description: MASISA S.A. is a wood products company headquartered in Chile with manufacturing operations across the Americas. Its products include solid wood, particleboard, MDF, OSB, interior doors, mouldings, and millwork. It is the second-largest company in its sector after Duratex.

mead-johnson.name: Mead Johnson
mead-johnson.description: Mead Johnson & Company, LLC is an American manufacturer of infant formula, known for its product Enfamil. It operates both domestically and globally. The company functions as an independent subsidiary of Reckitt.

medcoenergi.name: MedcoEnergi
medcoenergi.description: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk, or MedcoEnergi, is an Indonesian oil and gas company. It operates in trading, exploration, production of oil and gas, power, services, chemicals, and property rental.

melrose-industries.name: Melrose Industries
melrose-industries.description: Melrose Industries plc is a British aerospace manufacturing company based in Birmingham, England. It is the parent company of GKN Aerospace and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 100 Index.

mercialys.name: Mercialys
mercialys.industry: Rental of land and other real estate
mercialys.description: Mercialys is a French real estate company that owns and manages properties. It was created by the retailer Casino Group in 2005.

molinos-rio-de-la-plata.name: Molinos Río de la Plata
molinos-rio-de-la-plata.description: Molinos Río de la Plata is Argentina's largest branded food products company. It exports sunflower processed oil and bottled oil and produces a wide range of packaged foods for domestic consumption.

myriad-genetics.name: Myriad Genetics
myriad-genetics.description: Myriad Genetics, Inc. is an American genetic testing company based in Salt Lake City, Utah. Founded in 1991, it uses proprietary technologies to evaluate disease onset, progression, and treatment to guide product development.

mannatech.name: Mannatech
mannatech.description: Mannatech Inc. is a multinational multi-level marketing firm headquartered in Flower Mound, Texas. Founded in 1993, it sells dietary supplements and personal care products through independent sales associates worldwide.

metso.name: Metso
metso.description: Metso Corporation was a Finnish industrial machinery company specializing in technology and services for the mining and aggregates industries. It was based in Finland and focused on industrial machinery solutions.

mindtree.name: Mindtree
mindtree.description: Mindtree Limited was an Indian multinational information technology services and consulting company headquartered in Bangalore. It was acquired by Larsen & Toubro in 2019 and merged with L&T Infotech in 2022 to form LTIMindtree.

mediaset.name: Mediaset
mediaset.description: Mediaset S.p.A. is an Italian mass media and television production and distribution company. It is the largest commercial broadcaster in Italy and is controlled by MFE – MediaForEurope, majority-owned by the Berlusconi family's Fininvest Group.

mphasis.name: Mphasis
mphasis.description: Mphasis Limited is an Indian multinational IT service and consulting company based in Bengaluru. It offers infrastructure technology, application outsourcing, development, integration, and management services. Notably, Hewlett Packard Enterprise sold its majority stake in Mphasis to Blackstone Group in 2016.

modern-times-group.name: Modern Times Group
modern-times-group.description: Modern Times Group (MTG) is a digital entertainment company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. It originated from Kinnevik's media holdings and manages a portfolio including gaming companies and a digital network. MTG is an investment holding company.

mediacom.name: Mediacom
mediacom.description: Mediacom Communications Corporation is the fifth-largest cable television provider in the United States by video subscribers. Founded in 1995 and headquartered in New York, it focuses on serving smaller cities and towns, with a significant customer base in the Midwest and Southeast.

mulberry.name: Mulberry
mulberry.description: Mulberry Group PLC is a British fashion company founded in 1971. It is best known for its luxury leather goods, particularly women's handbags.

moltiply-group.name: Moltiply Group
moltiply-group.description: Moltiply Group S.p.A., formerly Gruppo MutuiOnline S.p.A. until 2024, is an Italian holding company based in Milan. It operates price comparison and online brokerage services for financial, insurance, utility, and e-commerce products in six countries and provides outsourcing and technology services to Italian banks and insurers.

manitowoc-cranes.name: Manitowoc Cranes
manitowoc-cranes.description: Manitowoc Cranes is a division of The Manitowoc Company, Inc. It produces five brands of cranes including Grove and National Crane. The company also operates two distribution businesses based in the U.S.: Aspen Equipment and MGX Equipment Services.

media-nusantara-citra.name: Media Nusantara Citra
media-nusantara-citra.description: PT Media Nusantara Citra Tbk, known as MNC Media, is an Indonesian media company. It operates four free-to-air TV networks and 19 pay TV channels, along with radio, print media, talent management, and production services. The company functions as an integrated media group.

magnite-inc.name: Magnite Inc
magnite-inc.description: Magnite Inc. is an American online advertising technology firm based in Los Angeles, California. It was formed in 2020 following a merger between Rubicon Project and Telaria.

mnc-corporation.name: MNC Corporation
mnc-corporation.description: PT MNC Asia Holding Tbk, known as the MNC Group, is an Indonesian conglomerate founded in 1989. It operates in mineral resources, mass media, and investment sectors. The company is based in Indonesia.

mcot.name: MCOT
mcot.description: MCOT Public Company Limited is a Thai state-owned public broadcaster based in Bangkok. It owns and operates multiple radio and television stations in Thailand.

ms-ad-insurance-group-holdings.name: MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings
ms-ad-insurance-group-holdings.description: MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese insurance company that includes Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance and Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance. It is publicly listed on the Nikkei 225 stock index.

mandiant.name: Mandiant
mandiant.description: Mandiant, Inc. is a United States cybersecurity firm and a subsidiary of Google. It was acquired by FireEye in 2013, later sold to Symphony Technology Group, and then acquired by Google in 2022, becoming part of Google Cloud.

mytheresa.name: Mytheresa
mytheresa.description: Mytheresa.com is part of the listed e-commerce group LuxExperience B.V. and operates in the luxury fashion sector based in Munich, Germany. It sells ready-to-wear clothing, shoes, bags, accessories, lifestyle products, and jewelry globally for women, men, and children.

mitsubishi-electric.name: Mitsubishi Electric
mitsubishi-electric.description: Mitsubishi Electric Corporation is a Japanese multinational electronics and electrical equipment manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo. Founded in 1921 as a spin-off from Mitsubishi Shipbuilding's electrical machinery division.

mdc-partners.name: MDC Partners
mdc-partners.description: MDC Partners Inc. is an advertising and marketing holding company based in New York City. It operates a partnership model acquiring majority stakes in partner agencies and has over 50 partner firms worldwide. In 2021, it merged with The Stagwell Group.

malvins-islands-holdings.name: Malvins Islands Holdings
malvins-islands-holdings.description: FIH Group plc, also known as Malvins Islands Holdings, is a British conglomerate operating in the Falkland Islands through the Falkland Islands Company. Its other businesses include the Portsmouth Harbour Ferry Company in England and a London-based art storage and transport company called Momart.

metro-city-bank.name: Metro City Bank
metro-city-bank.description: Metro City Bank is a Korean-American bank based in Doraville, Georgia. It offers personal and commercial banking services and operates 19 branches across several states including Texas and New York. It is the largest Korean-American bank not based in Los Angeles.

marubeni.name: Marubeni
marubeni.description: Marubeni Corporation is a sōgō shōsha headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is one of the largest general trading companies with leading market shares in cereal and paper pulp trading and a strong electrical and industrial plant business. It is a member of the Fuyo keiretsu.

marketaxess.name: MarketAxess
marketaxess.description: MarketAxess Holdings Inc. is headquartered in New York City and operates electronic trading platforms for bonds and fixed income products. Its customers are institutional investors and broker-dealers.

mdtv-media-technologies.name: MDTV Media Technologies
mdtv-media-technologies.description: PT MDTV Media Technologies Tbk is an Indonesian media company involved in television broadcasting, content production, artist management, and digital media. It is the holding company of MDTV and majority owned by MD Entertainment, led by producer Manoj Punjabi.

merlin-entertainments.name: Merlin Entertainments
merlin-entertainments.description: Merlin Entertainments Limited is a global entertainment company based in London, England. It operates various theme park resorts and visitor attractions. The company is owned by the consortium Motion JVCO Ltd, which includes Kirkbi, Blackstone Inc, and CPP Investments.

mattel.name: Mattel
mattel.description: Mattel, Inc. is an American multinational toy manufacturing and entertainment company headquartered in El Segundo, California. Founded in 1945, Mattel has a presence in 35 countries and sells its products in more than 150 countries worldwide.

matahari-department-store.name: Matahari Department Store
matahari-department-store.description: PT Matahari Department Store Tbk, known as Matahari, is the largest retail platform in Indonesia. It operates stores across the country and has an online presence through Matahari.com. The company is based in Indonesia.

major-cineplex.name: Major Cineplex
major-cineplex.description: Major Cineplex Group Public Co. Ltd. is the largest operator of movie theaters in Thailand and Laos. It operates 838 screens in 180 locations and owns Thailand's largest multiplex, Major Rangsit. The company is based in Thailand.

murata-manufacturing.name: Murata Manufacturing
murata-manufacturing.description: Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of electronic components based in Nagaokakyo, Kyoto. It produces ceramic passive electronic components and holds a majority market share worldwide in ceramic filters, high-frequency parts, and sensors. The company has 84 subsidiaries globally.

media-asia-entertainment-group.name: Media Asia Entertainment Group
media-asia-entertainment-group.description: Media Asia Entertainment Group is a Hong Kong production company and film distributor for films made in Hong Kong and China. It is a subsidiary of Lai Sun Development Company Ltd. The company operates in the cinematography industry.

makino.name: Makino
makino.description: Makino Milling Machine Co., Ltd., known as Makino, is a Japanese machine tool builder with global sales and service. The company is headquartered in Japan and operates in the industrial sector.

mitsubishi-corporation.name: Mitsubishi Corporation
mitsubishi-corporation.description: Mitsubishi Corporation is a Japanese general trading company and a core member of the Mitsubishi Group. It has been the largest of the five major sogo shosha in Japan by revenue and profits for much of the post-war period. The company operates in the wholesale industry.

mfs-investment-management.name: MFS Investment Management
mfs-investment-management.description: MFS Investment Management is an American global investment manager founded in 1924. It is one of the oldest asset management companies and pioneered the mutual fund, with its first fund still in operation today. The company was formerly known as Massachusetts Financial Services.

mge-energy-inc.name: MGE Energy, Inc.
mge-energy-inc.description: MGE Energy, Inc. is a utility holding company based in Madison, Wisconsin. Its main subsidiary, Madison Gas and Electric Co., produces and distributes electricity and distributes natural gas.

macerich.name: Macerich
macerich.description: The Macerich Company is an American real estate investment trust that invests in shopping centers. It is headquartered in Santa Monica, California, and was founded in 1964.

macquarie-infrastructure-company.name: Macquarie Infrastructure Company
macquarie-infrastructure-company.description: Macquarie Infrastructure Holdings, LLC, formerly Macquarie Infrastructure Corporation, owned and operated a diversified group of infrastructure businesses in the United States. It was headquartered in New York City and managed by Macquarie Infrastructure Management (USA) Inc., part of Sydney-based Macquarie Group Limited.

maiden-holdings.name: Maiden Holdings
maiden-holdings.description: Maiden Holdings Ltd. is a Bermuda-based holding company with insurance subsidiaries providing specialty reinsurance products for the global property and casualty market. It has operating subsidiaries in the United States, Europe, and Bermuda.

mainconcept.name: MainConcept
mainconcept.description: MainConcept is a German software company providing video and audio codecs since 1993. Their products serve industries including video production, multimedia, broadcast, and gaming, and are used by organizations such as Adobe and Sony.

malakoff.name: Malakoff
malakoff.description: Malakoff Corporation Berhad is a Malaysian independent water and power producer focusing on power generation, water desalination, operation and maintenance, and waste management. It is the largest independent power producer in Malaysia with six power plants.

mallinckrodt-pharmaceuticals.name: Mallinckrodt Pharmaceuticals
mallinckrodt-pharmaceuticals.description: Mallinckrodt Pharmaceuticals plc is an Irish-American manufacturer of specialty pharmaceuticals, generic drugs, and imaging agents. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry with significant sales from the U.S. healthcare system.

mantech-international.name: ManTech International
mantech-international.description: ManTech International is an American defense contracting firm based in Herndon, Virginia. Founded in 1968, it uses technology to support government and industry clients.

mandarake.name: Mandarake
mandarake.description: Mandarake Inc. is a Japanese retail corporation operating a chain of used goods stores. Founded in 1980 as a used manga bookstore, it now sells a wide range of collectables and otaku-related goods including anime, manga, toys, and video games.

mannkind-corporation.name: MannKind Corporation
mannkind-corporation.description: MannKind Corporation is a biopharmaceutical company based in Danbury, Connecticut. Founded in 1991, it focuses on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapeutic products for diseases like diabetes and pulmonary arterial hypertension.

moody-s-corporation.name: Moody's Corporation
moody-s-corporation.description: Moody's Corporation is an American business and financial services holding company. It owns Moody's Ratings, a credit rating agency, and Moody's, a provider of financial analysis software and services.

marcus-millichap.name: Marcus & Millichap
marcus-millichap.description: Marcus & Millichap, Inc. is an American company providing real estate brokerage, mortgage brokerage, research, and advisory services in commercial property across the U.S. and Canada. It operates over 80 offices with more than 1,800 employees.

markel-corporation.name: Markel Corporation
markel-corporation.description: Markel Group Inc. is a group of companies originally founded in 1930 as an insurance company. It is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia, United States. The company has a long history in the insurance industry.

marketo.name: Marketo
marketo.description: Marketo, Inc. is an American software company headquartered in San Mateo, California. It develops and sells marketing automation software for account-based marketing and other marketing services including SEO and content creation.

marriott-vacations-worldwide-corporation.name: Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation
marriott-vacations-worldwide-corporation.description: Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation is a public timeshare company based in the United States. It operates more than 120 resorts and manages various vacation ownership brands including Marriott Vacation Club and The Ritz-Carlton Destination Club.

martha-stewart-living-omnimedia.name: Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia
martha-stewart-living-omnimedia.description: Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia Inc. is an American diversified media and merchandising company founded in 1997. It operates in publishing, Internet, broadcasting media platforms, and merchandising product lines, including print publications and e-commerce websites.

martin-marietta-materials.name: Martin Marietta Materials
martin-marietta-materials.description: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. is an American company supplying aggregates, cement, asphalt, and heavy building materials. It operates in 26 states, Canada, and the Caribbean, providing resources for construction of roads, sidewalks, and foundations.

mastec.name: MasTec
mastec.description: Mastec, Inc. is an American infrastructure engineering and construction company based in Coral Gables, Florida. It provides engineering, building, installation, maintenance, and upgrade services for energy, utility, and communications infrastructure.

masco.name: Masco
masco.description: Masco Corporation is an American manufacturer of products for home improvement and new home construction markets. It operates nearly 80 manufacturing facilities worldwide and comprises more than 20 companies. Founded in the United States, it has been publicly traded on the NYSE since 1969.

menora-mivtachim-holdings-ltd.name: Menora Mivtachim Holdings Ltd
menora-mivtachim-holdings-ltd.description: Menora Mivtachim is an Israeli insurance company publicly traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. It operates within the insurance industry and is based in Israel.

materialise-nv.name: Materialise NV
materialise-nv.description: Materialise NV is a company headquartered in Leuven, Belgium, specializing in 3D printing and additive manufacturing. It operates in the technology sector focusing on innovative manufacturing solutions.

matson-inc.name: Matson, Inc.
matson-inc.description: Matson, Inc. is an American ocean transportation and logistics company headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaii. It provides shipping and logistics services primarily in the United States.

matsui-securities.name: Matsui Securities
matsui-securities.description: Matsui Securities is a Japanese financial company listed on the Nikkei 225. It operates in the banking and fintech industry and is based in Japan.

mattress-firm.name: Mattress Firm
mattress-firm.description: Mattress Firm, Inc. is an American mattress store chain founded in 1986 and headquartered in Houston, Texas. It became a subsidiary of Somnigroup International in 2025 following a merger with Temper Sealy.

maui-land-pineapple-company.name: Maui Land & Pineapple Company
maui-land-pineapple-company.description: Maui Land & Pineapple Company, Inc. is a land holding and operating company based in Kapalua, Hawaii. It develops and manages residential, resort, commercial, and industrial real estate, and operates retail and utility services at Kapalua Resort.

maxlinear.name: MaxLinear
maxlinear.description: MaxLinear, Inc. is an American electronic hardware company founded in 2003. It provides integrated radio-frequency analog and mixed-signal semiconductor products for broadband communications and is traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

mettler-toledo.name: Mettler Toledo
mettler-toledo.description: Mettler Toledo is a multinational supplier of precision instruments and services focused on laboratory, industrial, product inspection, and food retailing applications. It serves various industries including life sciences and chemicals, with a global workforce and diversified sales.

meadwestvaco.name: MeadWestvaco
meadwestvaco.description: MeadWestvaco Corporation was an American packaging company based in Richmond, Virginia. It employed approximately 23,000 people and moved its corporate headquarters to Richmond in 2006. In 2008, it started using "MWV" as its brand while retaining its legal name.

medcath-corp.name: MedCath Corp.
medcath-corp.description: MedCath Corporation was an American cardiac health care company founded in 1988. It offered cath lab, nuclear cardiology, and sleep medicine services and operated acute care cardiac hospitals. After the passage of ObamaCare, it sold its health care assets and dissolved.

media-prima.name: Media Prima
media-prima.description: Media Prima Berhad is a Malaysian media company based in Bangsar, Kuala Lumpur. It is the largest media and entertainment conglomerate in Malaysia with interests in television, print, radio, advertising, content creation, and digital media. It employs over 6,000 staff and forms half of the country's mass media duopoly.

medibank-private.name: Medibank Private
medibank-private.description: Medibank, formally Medibank Private Limited, is an Australian publicly-traded insurance and health services company headquartered in Melbourne. It is Australia's largest health fund with millions of customers. It started as a government-owned not-for-profit insurer in 1976 and was privatised in 2014.

medidata.name: MEDIDATA
medidata.description: Medidata Solutions is an American technology company headquartered in New York City that develops and markets software as a service for clinical trials. It has locations in several countries including China, Japan, and the UK. Since 2019, it has been a subsidiary of Dassault Systèmes.

medifast.name: Medifast
medifast.description: Medifast, Inc. is an American nutrition and weight loss company based in Baltimore, Maryland. It produces, distributes, and sells weight loss and health-related products through websites, multi-level marketing, telemarketing, and franchised clinics.

meetme.name: MeetMe
meetme.description: The Meet Group, Inc. owns several dating app networking services including MeetMe, hi5, and Tagged. The company has offices in New Hope, Philadelphia, San Francisco, Dresden, and Berlin.

meidensha.name: Meidensha
meidensha.description: Meidensha Corporation is a Tokyo-based Japanese company engaged in manufacturing and selling water treatment, electronic, and information equipment. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and is part of the Nikkei 225 index.

melewar-industrial-group.name: Melewar Industrial Group
melewar-industrial-group.description: Melewar Industrial Group Berhad is a Malaysian manufacturing company owned by the family of its late founder from the Negeri Sembilan royal family. It manufactures and trades steel products and is listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange. Its products serve construction, furniture, automotive, bicycle, and engineering industries.

mellanox-technologies.name: Mellanox Technologies
mellanox-technologies.description: Mellanox Technologies Ltd. was an Israeli-American multinational supplier of computer networking products based on InfiniBand and Ethernet technology. It offered adapters, switches, software, cables, and silicon for markets including high-performance computing, data centers, cloud computing, computer data storage, and financial services.

meralco.name: Meralco
meralco.description: The Manila Electric Company, known as Meralco, is the largest electric power distribution company in the Philippines. It is the sole electric power distributor in Metro Manila and holds the power distribution franchise for 39 cities and 72 municipalities, including all of Metro Manila and the exurbs forming Mega Manila.

mercian-corporation.name: Mercian Corporation
mercian-corporation.description: Mercian Corporation is a Tokyo-based operating unit of Kirin, primarily engaged in the production and retail of wine and other alcoholic beverages. It operates in Japan and focuses on alcoholic beverage markets.

mercury-energy.name: Mercury Energy
mercury-energy.description: Mercury NZ Limited is a New Zealand electricity generation and multi-product utility retailer offering electricity, gas, broadband, and mobile telephone services. All its electricity generation is renewable, and it is the largest electricity retailer in New Zealand.

meritage-homes-corporation.name: Meritage Homes Corporation
meritage-homes-corporation.description: Meritage Homes Corporation is a publicly traded American real estate development company that constructs various single-family detached homes across the United States. It is the fifth largest home builder in the U.S. and also develops active adult communities and luxury real estate in Arizona.

meru-networks.name: Meru Networks
meru-networks.description: Meru Networks was a supplier of wireless local area networks (WLANs) serving healthcare, enterprise, hospitality, education, and other markets. Founded in 2002 and based in Sunnyvale, California, it went public in 2010 and was acquired by Fortinet in 2015.

metro-bank.name: Metro Bank
metro-bank.description: Metro Bank PLC is a retail and commercial bank based in the United Kingdom. Founded in 2010 by Anthony Thomson and Vernon Hill, it was the first new high street bank to launch in the UK in over 150 years. The bank is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

michaels.name: Michaels
michaels.description: Michaels Stores, Inc., known as Michaels, is an American privately held arts and crafts retail chain. It is North America's largest provider of arts, crafts, framing, floral and wall décor products. The company is headquartered in Irving, Texas, and operates stores in the U.S. and Canada.

microsemi.name: Microsemi
microsemi.description: Microsemi Corporation was a provider of semiconductor and system solutions based in Aliso Viejo, California. It served markets including aerospace & defense, communications, data center, and industrial sectors.

midland-holdings.name: Midland Holdings
