midland-holdings.description: Midland Holdings Limited is one of the largest real estate brokerage companies in Hong Kong. It offers residential, industrial, and commercial property brokerage services in Hong Kong, Macau, and the People's Republic of China.

midwestone-financial-group.name: Midwestone Financial Group
midwestone-financial-group.description: MidWestOne Financial Group, Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Iowa City, Iowa. It operates 56 bank branches across Iowa, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Colorado, and Florida, and is the third-largest bank headquartered in Iowa.

migdal-insurance-financial-holdings-ltd.name: Migdal Insurance & Financial Holdings Ltd.
migdal-insurance-financial-holdings-ltd.description: Migdal Insurance and Financial Holdings Ltd. is an Israeli public holding company owning various companies in insurance and financial services, primarily the Migdal Insurance Company. Founded in 1974, its shares have been traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange since 1997 and are part of the TA-125 Index.

minor-international.name: Minor International
minor-international.description: Minor International is a Thai multinational company based in Bangkok. Its core businesses include hospitality, restaurants, and lifestyle brand distribution through subsidiaries Minor Hotels, Minor Food, and Minor Lifestyle.

miramar-hotel-and-investment.name: Miramar Hotel and Investment
miramar-hotel-and-investment.description: Miramar Hotel and Investment Company Limited operates hotels, serviced apartments, property rental, food and beverage, and travel services in Hong Kong and mainland China. It has been listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 1970 and is part of Henderson Land Group.

mobily.name: Mobily
mobily.description: Mobily, officially Etihad Etisalat Company, is a Saudi Arabian telecommunications services provider offering fixed line, mobile telephony, and Internet services.

modernform-group.name: Modernform Group
modernform-group.description: Modernform Group Public Company Limited is a manufacturer and distributor of home and office furniture based in Thailand. The company is publicly listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand since March 11, 1992.

mohawk-industries.name: Mohawk Industries
mohawk-industries.description: Mohawk Industries is an American flooring manufacturer based in Calhoun, Georgia. It produces various floor covering products for residential and commercial use in North America and Europe, including soft and hard flooring, laminate, vinyl, natural stone, and quartz countertops. It operates globally with 40,500 employees.

mayr-melnhof.name: Mayr-Melnhof
mayr-melnhof.description: Mayr-Melnhof Karton AG is a manufacturer in the paper and packaging industry based in Vienna, Austria. The company is 65% family owned and publicly traded on the Vienna Stock Exchange.

molina-healthcare.name: Molina Healthcare
molina-healthcare.description: Molina Healthcare, Inc. is an American managed care company headquartered in Long Beach, California. It provides health insurance to individuals through government programs such as Medicaid and Medicare.

monex-group.name: Monex Group
monex-group.description: Monex Group, Inc. is a financial services company based in Tokyo, Japan. Its main subsidiary, Monex Inc., offers online securities trading with about 2 million accounts. The group also owns US-based TradeStation and acquired Japan's crypto exchange Coincheck in 2018.

mony-group.name: MONY Group
mony-group.description: MONY Group plc, trading as MoneySuperMarket, is a British company specializing in technology-led money-saving platforms including price comparison websites. It operates several subsidiaries and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

monro-muffler-brake.name: Monro Muffler Brake
monro-muffler-brake.description: Monro, Inc. is an automotive services company headquartered in Rochester, New York, United States. It operates 1,260 locations, making it the second-largest automotive services company in North America by number of locations and revenue as of 2025.

morinaga-milk-industry.name: Morinaga Milk Industry
morinaga-milk-industry.description: Morinaga Milk Industry Co., Ltd. is a Tokyo-based Japanese company producing milk products, drinks, candy, confectioneries, and infant formula. Founded in 1917, it has subsidiaries and distribution agreements with companies like Mondelez International.

mortgage-guaranty-insurance-corporation.name: Mortgage Guaranty Insurance Corporation
mortgage-guaranty-insurance-corporation.description: MGIC Investment Corporation is a provider of private mortgage insurance in the United States. The company is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

mundial-s-a.name: Mundial S.A.
mundial-s-a.description: Mundial is a Brazilian multinational manufacturing company producing beauty care implements and apparel fasteners. It was formed from the merger of Eberle S.A. and Zivi-Hercules, companies founded in 1896 and 1931 respectively.

murray-roberts.name: Murray & Roberts
murray-roberts.description: Murray & Roberts Holdings Ltd is a major South African engineering and mining corporation. It operates in the resources, industrial, energy, water, and specialized infrastructure sectors. The company was listed on the JSE Limited.

musclepharm.name: MusclePharm
musclepharm.description: MusclePharm Corporation is an American nutritional supplement company founded in 2006 in Denver, Colorado, and headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. It operates in the consumer goods and retail industry.

mushkin.name: Mushkin
mushkin.description: Mushkin is an American computer hardware company known for producing computer memory modules (RAM). It offers products including solid-state drives, power supply units, and USB flash drives, catering to gamers and industry professionals.

morphosys.name: Morphosys
morphosys.description: MorphoSys AG is a German biopharmaceutical company headquartered near Munich. It develops proprietary and partnered drug candidates using antibody, protein, and peptide technologies, focusing on cancer and autoimmune diseases.

msci.name: MSCI
msci.description: MSCI Inc. is an American finance company headquartered in New York City. It provides global equity, fixed income, real estate indices, portfolio analysis tools, and ESG and climate finance products, operating well-known indices like MSCI World and MSCI Emerging Markets.

mecklermedia.name: Mecklermedia
mecklermedia.description: Mecklermedia was a U.S.-based corporation headquartered in New York. Founded by Alan M. Meckler and Tristan Louis, it provided business-to-business services including recruitment and event promotion for creative, business, and IT professionals.

mainsource-bank.name: MainSource Bank
mainsource-bank.description: MainSource Bank was a community bank based in Greensburg, Indiana, operating in Indiana, Illinois, Kentucky, and Ohio. It was the operating subsidiary of MainSource Financial Group and was acquired by First Financial Bancorp in 2018, leading to the closure or rebranding of its locations.

molten-ventures.name: Molten Ventures
molten-ventures.description: Molten Ventures, formerly Draper Esprit, is a British venture capital firm investing in high growth technology companies globally. It has offices in London, Cambridge, and Dublin, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

mitsubishi-pencil.name: Mitsubishi Pencil
mitsubishi-pencil.description: Mitsubishi Pencil Company Limited is a Japanese manufacturer known for its Uniball and Uni brands of pens and pencils. The Uniball brand was introduced in 1979 as a rollerball pen and later expanded to other products.

movado.name: Movado
movado.description: Movado is a luxury American watch brand originally founded in Switzerland in 1881. It is known for its minimalist style and the signature metallic dot at 12 o'clock on its watches.

murphy-oil.name: Murphy Oil
murphy-oil.description: Murphy Oil Corporation is an American energy company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration. It is headquartered in Houston, Texas, and is ranked 995th on the Fortune 500 list.

mengniu-dairy.name: Mengniu Dairy
mengniu-dairy.description: Inner Mongolia Mengniu Dairy (Group) Limited is a Chinese company headquartered in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia. It manufactures and distributes dairy products and ice cream under the Mengniu brand.

metro-group.name: METRO Group
metro-group.description: Metro AG is a German multinational food wholesaler based in Düsseldorf. It supplies hotels, restaurants, caterers, and independent retailers through cash-and-carry stores and direct delivery. Its stores mainly operate under the Metro and Makro brands across 21 countries.

mol-group.name: MOL Group
mol-group.description: MOL Plc., also known as MOL Group, is a Hungarian multinational oil and gas company headquartered in Budapest. It includes Croatian and Slovak formerly state-owned companies INA and Slovnaft. MOL is Hungary's second most profitable enterprise and was ranked 402 on the Fortune Global 500 list in 2013.

mexican-red-cross.name: Mexican Red Cross
mexican-red-cross.description: The Mexican Red Cross is a non-governmental humanitarian organization affiliated with the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. It provides aid in dangerous situations and health services, funded by volunteers and donations. It was established by presidential decree in 1910 and recognized internationally in 1912.

maroc-telecom.name: Maroc Telecom
maroc-telecom.description: Maroc Telecom is a telecommunications company in Morocco and the largest network in the country. It employs around 11,178 people and operates 8 regional delegations and 220 offices across Morocco. The company is listed on the Casablanca Stock Exchange and Euronext Paris.

mosenergo.name: Mosenergo
mosenergo.description: Mosenergo is a Russian power-generating company founded in 1887 and based in Moscow. It operates fossil fuel and thermal power generation and supplies both electric power and heat to consumers in Moscow and the Moscow Oblast.

marjane-group.name: Marjane Group
marjane-group.description: Marjane Group is a Moroccan retail company operating a nationwide network of hypermarkets and supermarkets under the Marjane and Marjane Market brands. It is wholly owned by the Al Mada holding company. The company serves the retail market in Morocco.

metlen-energy-metals.name: Metlen Energy & Metals
metlen-energy-metals.description: Metlen Energy & Metals is a global industrial and energy conglomerate based in Greece. It operates in two sectors: Energy and Metallurgy. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

movistar-argentina.name: Movistar Argentina
movistar-argentina.description: Movistar Argentina is an Argentine telecommunications company and a subsidiary of Telefónica Group. It has operated under various trade names including Miniphone and Unifón, and adopted the Movistar brand after merging with Movicom BellSouth in 2005.

mega-brands.name: Mega Brands
mega-brands.description: Mega Brands Inc. is a Canadian children's toy company and a wholly owned subsidiary of Mattel. It distributes a wide range of construction toys, puzzles, and craft-based products, with Mega Bloks being its most popular product line.

movitel.name: Movitel
movitel.description: Movitel is a mobile telecommunications operator based in Maputo, Mozambique. It operates through 12 subsidiaries across 11 provinces and is a partnership between Vietnamese company Viettel and Mozambique's SPI.

metro.name: Metro
metro.description: Metro Inc. is a Canadian supermarket chain operating in Quebec and Ontario. Based in Montreal, Quebec, it is the third-largest grocer in Canada after Loblaw Companies Limited and Sobeys.

mci-capital.name: MCI Capital
mci-capital.description: MCI Capital SA is a private equity fund established in 1999 and listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange. Founded by Tomasz Czechowicz, it is recognized as one of Poland’s leading private equity companies. The company manages assets under management of 2.74 billion PLN as of September 2024.

moj.name: MOJ
moj.description: MOJ was a brand of motorcycles manufactured in Katowice, Poland from 1937 to 1939. The brand name derives from the nickname of its founder, Gustaw Różycki, from his time as a student at the University of Leoben. The brand is now defunct.

martinrea.name: Martinrea
martinrea.description: Martinrea International Inc. is an auto parts manufacturer based in Vaughan, Ontario, Canada. It operates in North America, Europe, and Asia, serving as a supplier for major automakers including General Motors, Toyota, and Ford.

makolab.name: MakoLab
makolab.description: MakoLab is an international IT company headquartered in Łódź, Poland, specializing in business web software. It has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2007 and collaborates on R&D projects with John Paul II University in Lublin. The company has offices in Poland, Paris, London, Munich, and Tampa.

mcbride-plc.name: McBride plc
mcbride-plc.description: McBride plc is a British manufacturing business and Europe's largest maker of retailer own brand household goods. It also provides contract manufacturing services and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

macrogen.name: Macrogen
macrogen.description: Macrogen, Inc. is a South Korean biotechnology company headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1997, it was the first Korean biotech firm to raise funds through an IPO on the KOSDAQ market. The company has been involved in genomic mapping and personalized genomic medicine.

modern-water.name: Modern Water
modern-water.description: Modern Water plc is a British company listed on the AIM submarket of the London Stock Exchange since 2007. It owns, installs, and operates advanced membrane technologies and develops systems for water monitoring.

magellan-aerospace.name: Magellan Aerospace
magellan-aerospace.description: Magellan Aerospace Corporation is a Canadian manufacturer of aerospace systems and components. It also offers repair, overhaul, testing, and aftermarket support for engines and structural components. The company operates in Canada, the United States, and the United Kingdom with corporate offices in Mississauga, Ontario.

molex.name: Molex
molex.description: Molex, LLC is a manufacturer of electronic, electrical, and fiber optic connectivity systems based in the United States. It produces over 100,000 products for various industries and is known for pioneering the Molex connector widely adopted in personal computing.

morgan-crucible.name: Morgan Crucible
morgan-crucible.description: Morgan Advanced Materials plc is a UK-based company headquartered in Windsor that manufactures specialist products using carbon, advanced ceramics, and composites. It operates 57 sites worldwide and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as a public limited company.

milacron.name: Milacron
milacron.description: Milacron, LLC is an American company that manufactures and distributes plastic processing equipment such as injection and extrusion molding machines. It is part of Hillenbrand, Inc., which acquired it in 2019.

mellat-investment-bank.name: Mellat Investment Bank
mellat-investment-bank.description: Bank Mellat is an Iranian bank established in 1980 through the merger of ten pre-1979 private banks. Its name means "Bank of the Nation" and it is one of the most active banks in Iran.

maple-leaf-foods.name: Maple Leaf Foods
maple-leaf-foods.description: Maple Leaf Foods Inc. is a Canadian multinational company specializing in consumer-packaged meats and food production. Its head office is located in Mississauga, Ontario.

mekorot.name: Mekorot
mekorot.description: Mekorot is Israel's national water company and the leading agency for water management in the country. Founded in 1937, it supplies about 80% of Israel's drinking water and operates the National Water Carrier. Mekorot also partners internationally in desalination and water management projects.

mca-inc.name: MCA Inc.
mca-inc.description: MCA Inc. was an American media conglomerate operating from 1924 to 1996. It started as a talent agency in the music business and expanded into film, television production, and music publishing. MCA also ran MCA Records and produced TV programs for major networks.

mobarakeh-steel-company.name: Mobarakeh Steel Company
mobarakeh-steel-company.description: Mobarakeh Steel Company is a private Iranian steel producer located near Mobarakeh, Isfahan Province. It is the largest steel maker in the MENA region and one of Iran's largest industrial complexes. The company owns the football club Sepahan F.C. and several other industrial assets.

masi-index.name: MASI index
masi-index.description: The MASI is a stock index tracking all companies listed on the Casablanca Stock Exchange in Morocco. It is one of the two main indexes at the exchange, alongside the MADEX.

mostotrest.name: Mostotrest
mostotrest.description: Mostotrest is the largest heavy construction company in Russia. It focuses on building roads, railways, bridges, highways, and other engineering structures. The company operates within the construction industry in Russia.

mint-of-poland.name: Mint of Poland
mint-of-poland.description: The Mint of Poland is a private joint-stock company located in Warsaw and is the only private entity permitted to mint coins and investment products in Poland. It has been publicly traded on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 1998, making it the only publicly traded mint worldwide.

mapna.name: MAPNA
mapna.description: MAPNA Group is a group of Iranian companies involved in the development and execution of thermal and renewable power plants, oil & gas, railway transportation, and other industrial projects. It also manufactures main equipment including gas and steam turbines, electrical generators, and locomotives.

meg-energy.name: MEG Energy
meg-energy.description: MEG Energy is a Canadian oil sands producer focused on exploration in the Athabasca oil sands. It operates as a pure play company in the petroleum industry based in Canada.

mitie-group.name: MITIE Group
mitie-group.description: Mitie Group PLC is a British strategic outsourcing and energy services company headquartered at The Shard in London. It provides infrastructure consultancy, facilities management, property management, energy, and healthcare services across the UK and Ireland. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

mty-food-group.name: MTY Food Group
mty-food-group.description: MTY Food Group Inc. is a Canadian franchisor and operator of numerous casual dining, fast casual, and quick service restaurants under more than 70 brand names. It is headquartered in Saint-Laurent, Montreal, Quebec. The company owns the American division Kahala Brands, acquired in 2016.

mad-catz.name: Mad Catz
mad-catz.description: Mad Catz, Inc. is an American third-party manufacturer and brand of video gaming products and accessories. Originally a Chinese company until its 2017 bankruptcy, it was relaunched in 2018 and is now produced by Hong Kong-based Mad Catz Global Limited.

madeco.name: Madeco
madeco.description: Madeco S.A. is a Chilean diversified industrial group manufacturing flexible packaging, copper tubes, and aluminum and PVC window and door profiles. It operates in Chile, Argentina, Colombia, and Peru through its subsidiary Alusa.

major-drilling-group-international.name: Major Drilling Group International
major-drilling-group-international.description: Major Drilling Group International Inc. is the world's largest mineral drilling company serving the mining industry.

mannesmann.name: Mannesmann
mannesmann.description: Mannesmann was a German industrial conglomerate originally established in 1890 as a steel pipe manufacturer. It expanded into steel products, mechanical and electrical engineering, automotive, and telecommunications, with headquarters in Düsseldorf.

marin-software.name: Marin Software
marin-software.description: Marin Software Incorporated was an online advertising company based in San Francisco. Founded in 2006, it went public in 2013 and was dissolved in 2025 after declaring bankruptcy.

marshalls-plc.name: Marshalls plc
marshalls-plc.description: Marshalls plc is a United Kingdom based manufacturer of natural stone and concrete hard landscaping products. It supplies the construction, home improvement, and landscape markets and is based in Elland, West Yorkshire.

meade-instruments.name: Meade Instruments
meade-instruments.description: Meade Instruments Corporation was an American multinational company headquartered in Watsonville, California. It manufactured and distributed telescopes and related optical instruments for the consumer market and was once the world's largest telescope manufacturer.

moog-inc.name: Moog Inc.
moog-inc.description: Moog Inc. is an American designer and manufacturer of electric, electro-hydraulic, and hydraulic motion controls and systems. Headquartered in Elma, New York, it serves aerospace, defense, industrial, and medical device markets with operations in 26 countries.

moss-bros-group.name: Moss Bros Group
moss-bros-group.description: Moss Bros Group is a UK-based menswear retailer founded in 1851 and headquartered in London. It specializes in dresswear for formal occasions and operates 113 shops across the United Kingdom.

meeza.name: Meeza
meeza.description: Meeza is an Egyptian electronic payment systems provider focused on domestic transactions within Egypt. Supported by the Egyptian government and regulated by the Egyptian Central Bank and the national Egyptian Banks Company, Meeza offers services similar to MasterCard and Visa but is limited to local use.

ministry-of-justice-of-cameroon.name: Ministry of Justice of Cameroon
ministry-of-justice-of-cameroon.description: The Ministry of Justice of Cameroon administers the country's justice system and prison system since early 2005. It also shares responsibility for human rights administration. The ministry operates within a complex legal framework including elements of Code Napoleon, Common Law, and customary law.

madina-air.name: Madina Air
madina-air.description: Madina Air was a privately owned airline based in Tripoli, Libya, established in 2009. It operated charter flights supporting oil field operations and provided some scheduled and ad hoc charter services.

malawi-posts-corporation.name: Malawi Posts Corporation
malawi-posts-corporation.description: Malawi Posts Corporation (MPC) is the statutory corporation responsible for postal services and some financial services in Malawi.

malawi-airlines.name: Malawi Airlines
malawi-airlines.description: Malawi Airlines is the flag carrier airline of Malawi, based in Lilongwe with its hub at Kamuzu International Airport. Established in 2012 after Air Malawi's liquidation, it is operated under a management contract by Ethiopian Airlines, which owns 49 percent of the airline.

mauritanian-post-company.name: Mauritanian Post Company
mauritanian-post-company.description: La Société Mauritanienne des Postes, or Mauripost, is the official postal operator of Mauritania. Founded in 1999, it is responsible for postal services and became a regular member of the Universal Postal Union in 1967.

mauritel.name: Mauritel
mauritel.description: Mauritel is a principal telecommunications company in Mauritania, established in 1999 in Nouakchott. On January 1, 2021, it adopted the commercial name Moov Mauritel and launched Mauritania's first 4G network.

mauritania-airlines.name: Mauritania Airlines
mauritania-airlines.description: Mauritania Airlines, based in Nouakchott, is the flag carrier airline of Mauritania. Established in December 2010 after Mauritania Airways ceased operations, it rebranded in April 2018 and is the only airline flying domestically within Mauritania.

mauritius-telecom.name: Mauritius Telecom
mauritius-telecom.description: Mauritius Telecom (MT) is a telecommunications company in Mauritius. As of December 2019, it served hundreds of thousands of fixed line, mobile, fibre-ready, IPTV, and broadband internet customers.

medi-1-tv.name: Medi 1 TV
medi-1-tv.description: Medi 1 TV is a news television network based in Tangier, Morocco. Launched in 2006 as a satellite broadcaster, it expanded to terrestrial and digital platforms and is part of Medi 1 News, which also operates a radio station founded in 1980.

marjane-market.name: Marjane Market
marjane-market.description: Marjane Market is a supermarket chain in Morocco. It is part of the Marjane Group and is fully owned by Al Mada, the holding company of King Mohammed VI.

mozambique-stock-exchange.name: Mozambique Stock Exchange
mozambique-stock-exchange.description: The Mozambique Stock Exchange, known as Bolsa de Valores de Moçambique or Maputo Stock Exchange, is the first stock exchange in Mozambique. It opened in 1999 with support from the Lisbon Stock Exchange and the World Bank.

millennium-bim.name: Millennium bim
millennium-bim.description: Millennium bim is a Mozambican bank founded in 1995 through a partnership between Banco Comercial Português and the Mozambican state. It is one of the largest banks in Mozambique, providing various banking services.

mocambique-expresso.name: Moçambique Expresso
mocambique-expresso.description: Moçambique Expresso is an airline based in Beira, Mozambique. It operates domestic and regional scheduled and charter flights, with its main base at Maputo International Airport.

mtc-namibia.name: MTC Namibia
mtc-namibia.description: Mobile Telecommunications Limited (MTC) is a mobile telecommunications company and internet service provider in Namibia. Established in 1995, it is the largest mobile carrier in the country with over two million active subscribers.

mavin-records.name: Mavin Records
mavin-records.description: Mavin Records is a Nigerian record label founded by Don Jazzy in 2012 after the closure of Mo' Hits Records. It houses various recording artists and producers and has released compilation albums including Solar Plexus and Chapter X.

ministry-of-energy-and-mineral-resources.name: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (Lagos)
ministry-of-energy-and-mineral-resources.legal_name: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (Lagos)
ministry-of-energy-and-mineral-resources.description: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources is a Lagos State government ministry in Nigeria. It is responsible for planning, devising, and implementing state policies on energy and mineral resources. The ministry oversees energy-related development in Lagos State.

mikano-international-limited.name: Mikano International Limited
mikano-international-limited.description: Mikano International Limited is a Nigerian company operating in power generation, real estate, and construction sectors. It offers sales, maintenance, assembly, and distribution of power generation products, real estate development, and construction equipment sales.

merchant-express-aviation.name: Merchant Express Aviation
merchant-express-aviation.description: Merchant Express Aviation was a cargo airline operating out of Lagos, Nigeria.

mr-bigg-s.name: Mr Bigg's
mr-bigg-s.description: Mr Bigg's is a Nigerian fast food restaurant chain owned by United African Company of Nigeria PLC. It operates multiple locations including Nigeria's first drive-through restaurant and had a 49% stake acquired by Famous Brands in 2013.

mo-hits-records.name: Mo' Hits Records
mo-hits-records.description: Mo'Hits Records was a Nigerian record label founded in 2004 by D'banj and Don Jazzy. Don Jazzy served as CEO and the label signed artists including Wande Coal, Dr SID, D'Prince, and K-Switch.

moniepoint-inc.name: Moniepoint Inc
moniepoint-inc.description: Moniepoint is a Nigerian fintech company based in Lagos that provides banking services and loans via an online app. It was founded in 2015, and in November 2024, Bayo Olujobi was appointed its CFO.

max-air.name: Max Air
max-air.description: Max Air is a Nigerian airline operating domestic and international flights. Established in 2008 by Alhaji Dahiru Barau Mangal, its head office is located in Kano State with its base at Mallam Aminu Kano International Airport, Kano.

mtn-uganda.name: MTN Uganda
mtn-uganda.description: MTN Uganda is the largest telecommunications company in Uganda, holding a significant market share of mobile subscribers. It operates within Uganda's telecommunications industry.

mid-airlines.name: Mid Airlines
mid-airlines.description: Mid Airlines is a charter airline based in Khartoum, Sudan, operating domestic passenger services. Its main base is Khartoum International Airport, and it is currently banned from flying in EU airspace.

mr-miss-akuapem.name: Mr & Miss Akuapem
mr-miss-akuapem.description: Mr. & Miss Akuapem is an annual unisex beauty pageant in Ghana focused on the culture of the Akuapem people in the Eastern region. The pageant aims to promote development through culture and unity.

mesbla.name: Mesbla
mesbla.description: Mesbla S.A. was a Brazilian department store chain founded in 1912 as a subsidiary of a French firm. The company declared bankruptcy in 1999.

muricy.name: Muricy
muricy.description: Muricy was a Brazilian department store chain founded in 1976 and dissolved in 1998. It also operated in Chile between 1981 and 1990.

mascarello.name: Mascarello
mascarello.description: Mascarello Carrocerias de Ônibus is a Brazilian bus and coach manufacturer based in Cascavel, Paraná state.

modern-logistics.name: Modern Logistics
modern-logistics.description: Modern Logistics, officially Modern Transporte Aéreo de Carga, is a Brazilian integrated cargo and logistics airline founded in 2014. It is headquartered in Jundiaí, São Paulo, and was founded by executives from Azul Linhas Aéreas.

mais-linhas-aereas.name: Mais Linhas Aéreas
mais-linhas-aereas.description: Mais Linhas Aéreas S/A was an airline based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, founded in 2010. It was authorized to operate domestic regular and non-regular flights.

map-linhas-aereas.name: MAP Linhas Aéreas
map-linhas-aereas.description: MAP Linhas Aéreas was a Brazilian domestic airline headquartered in Manaus, Amazonas. Founded in 2011, it operated regular and non-regular charter flights within Brazil and was the fifth largest airline in the country by domestic market share in 2023.

manaus-aerotaxi.name: Manaus Aerotáxi
manaus-aerotaxi.description: Manaus Aerotáxi is a non-scheduled airline and air taxi company headquartered in Manaus, Brazil. It specializes in charter flights and air medical services certified under Brazilian Civil Aviation Regulations.

massmart.name: Massmart
massmart.description: Massmart Holdings Limited is a South African retail company owning multiple major local chains such as Game, Makro, Builders Warehouse, and CBW. It is the second-largest distributor of consumer goods in Africa.

mugg-bean.name: Mugg & Bean
mugg-bean.description: Mugg & Bean is a full-service coffee-themed restaurant franchise founded in Cape Town, South Africa. It operates in the retail sector.

mango.name: Mango
mango.description: Mango Airlines SOC Ltd, trading as Mango, was a South African low-cost airline based at O. R. Tambo International Airport. It was a subsidiary of South African Airways and has been grounded since July 2021, with its license suspended in August 2022.

multichoice.name: MultiChoice
multichoice.description: MultiChoice is a South African company owned by French media conglomerate Canal+. It operates DStv, a major satellite television service in Sub-Saharan Africa, and GOtv, a terrestrial TV service in nine countries. It formerly operated Showmax, a subscription video on-demand streaming service.

mallplaza.name: Mallplaza
mallplaza.description: Mallplaza S.A. is a Chilean chain of shopping malls operated in South America by Falabella. The company manages retail mall properties across the region.

mostaza.name: Mostaza
mostaza.description: Mostaza, SA is an Argentine fast food chain established in 1998. It specializes in hamburgers, sandwiches, desserts, and café items. It is the second largest fast food chain in Argentina after McDonald's.

motomel.name: Motomel
motomel.description: Motomel S.A. is an Argentine motorcycle brand based in Buenos Aires Province. It was founded in 1992 by the La Emilia investment group. The company specializes in manufacturing motorcycles.

mercedes-benz-argentina.name: Mercedes-Benz Argentina
mercedes-benz-argentina.description: Mercedes-Benz Argentina S.A.U. is the Argentine subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz Group, producing and marketing utility vehicles. Established in 1951, it has an assembly plant in Virrey del Pino where trucks and buses are produced, and it imports luxury models including sedans and SUVs.

muky.name: Muky
muky.description: Muky was an Argentine brand of die-cast toy model cars popular in Argentina between the 1970s and the 1980s. Most models were diecast seconds or knockoffs of early Mattel Hot Wheels. The brand is no longer active.

minsur.name: Minsur
minsur.description: Minsur is a Peru-based mining company engaged in extracting and refining tin and copper. It also explores for new mineral deposits including gold, silver, lead, and zinc ores.

modasa.name: Modasa
modasa.description: MODASA is a Peruvian bus manufacturer located in Ate District. It produces buses, cars including pick-up trucks, and offers automobile conversions to natural gas. The company also manufactures generators and mobile generators.

mid-express-tchad.name: Mid Express Tchad
mid-express-tchad.description: Mid Express Tchad was a cargo airline based in N'Djamena, Chad. Established as AMW Tchad in 2007, it was rebranded as Mid-Express Tchad in 2008. The airline focused on cargo transport.

monte-avila-editores.name: Monte Ávila Editores
monte-avila-editores.description: Monte Ávila Editores is the largest publishing house in Venezuela. Between 1980 and 2000, it published over 300 titles, mainly by Venezuelan authors, producing more than 1.2 million copies.

mercantil-bank.name: Mercantil Bank
mercantil-bank.description: Mercantil Banco is a financial institution based in Venezuela with over 100 years of banking activity. It operates as a subsidiary of Mercantil Servicios Financieros. The bank has a long-standing presence in the Venezuelan financial sector.

manufacturing-commercial-vehicles.name: Manufacturing Commercial Vehicles
manufacturing-commercial-vehicles.description: Manufacturing Commercial Vehicles (MCV) is an Egyptian manufacturer of buses and trucks. Its manufacturing plant is located in El Salheya El Gedida, with the head office in Obour City near Cairo. The company owns trademark rights for brands including ECHOLINE and MCV.

mcv-bus-and-coach.name: MCV Bus and Coach
mcv-bus-and-coach.description: MCV Bus and Coach is an Egyptian manufacturer of bus bodies founded in 2002. The company was established when Manufacturing Commercial Vehicles acquired some design rights from the defunct English bus builder Marshall Bus. It operates in the automotive industry in Egypt.

mali-development-bank.name: Mali Development Bank
mali-development-bank.description: Banque du Développement du Mali is a bank based in Mali. It operates within the banking sector in the country.

mali-red-cross.name: Mali Red Cross
mali-red-cross.description: Mali Red Cross, founded in 1965 and headquartered in Bamako, provides aid related to armed conflict, nutrition, health, and food shortages. It is recognized by the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies as Mali's national society.

mali-airways.name: Mali Airways
mali-airways.description: Mali Airways was an airline founded in Mali in 2015. However, it never commenced operations.

movicel.name: Movicel
movicel.description: Movicel Telecomunicações S.A. is the smaller of two Angolan mobile phone companies, originally created as a subsidiary of Angola Telecom. Since 2010, 80% of its capital is privately owned, with the remainder held by state-owned companies.

multicaixa.name: Multicaixa
multicaixa.description: Multicaixa (MCX) is the only brand for debit cards issued in Angola and operates the sole interbank network of ATMs and point of sale terminals. The network is operated by EMIS and regulated by national laws governing payment systems.

monoprix.name: Monoprix
monoprix.description: SNMVT Monoprix is a chain of grocery stores in Tunisia with its head office in Mégrine. It is operated by Groupe Mabrouk and has been listed on the Bourse de Tunis since April 1995. The company is a key player in the Tunisian retail market.

mahogany-air.name: Mahogany Air
mahogany-air.description: Mahogany Air is a regional airline based in Lusaka, Zambia, with its hub at Lusaka International Airport. Its corporate headquarters are located at East Park Mall on Great East Road in Lusaka.

megacable.name: Megacable
megacable.description: Megacable Holdings S. A. B. de C.V., known as Megacable Comunicaciones, is a Mexican cable operator providing internet and phone services. The company is headquartered in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico.

minera-san-xavier.name: Minera San Xavier
minera-san-xavier.hq: Cerro de San Pedro Municipality, Mexico
minera-san-xavier.description: Minera San Xavier was an open-pit mine in San Luis Potosí, Mexico, and a subsidiary of Canadian company New Gold Inc. It operated a gold and silver mine near Cerro de San Pedro. The mine is now closed after a lengthy closing process.

mercedes-benz-mexico.name: Mercedes-Benz Mexico
mercedes-benz-mexico.description: Mercedes-Benz Mexico is a subsidiary of the Mercedes-Benz Group, headquartered in Mexico City. It operates within the automotive industry in Mexico, representing the global Mercedes-Benz brand locally.

musart.name: Musart
musart.industry: Manufacturing and Reproducing Magnetic and Optical Media
musart.description: Discos Musart, or Musart Records, is a Mexican record label founded in 1948 in Mexico City and now headquartered in Miami, Florida. It produces, publishes, and distributes Latin music with a focus on regional Mexican genres, managing a large catalog of copyrights and master recordings.

masair-cargo-mexico.name: MasAir Cargo Mexico
masair-cargo-mexico.description: MasAir Cargo Mexico is a Mexican cargo airline based in Mexico City specializing in wide-body aircraft transport. It operates scheduled and charter services across the Americas, Asia, and Europe from its main hub at Felipe Ángeles International Airport and secondary hubs in Los Angeles and Zaragoza.

magnicharters.name: Magnicharters
magnicharters.description: Magnicharters, operated by Grupo Aereo Monterrey, was an airline headquartered in Mexico City. It operated domestic holiday flights out of Mexico City International Airport.

mayair.name: MAYAir
mayair.description: MAYAir is a regional airline based in Cancún, Quintana Roo, Mexico. Its main operational base is Mérida International Airport. The airline provides regional passenger air services.

mascom.name: Mascom
mascom.description: Mascom Wireless Proprietary Limited is a mobile telecommunications company headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana. It was established on February 17, 1998.

mack-air.name: Mack Air
mack-air.description: Mack Air is a charter airline based in Maun, Botswana, operating in northern Botswana since 1994.

miba-aviation.name: MIBA Aviation
miba-aviation.hq: Mbuji-Mayi, Democratic Republic of the Congo
miba-aviation.description: MIBA Aviation was a cargo airline based in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Established in 1994, it operated Boeing 727 and Hawker Siddeley HS 125 aircraft. The airline ceased operations in 2005 after a Boeing 727 was written off.
